title: Echoes Upon the Gale

outfit_card.silhouette: An ethereal off-shoulder gown with a layered tulle skirt, cascading asymmetric drapery, a structured corseted bodice, and detached sheer arm drapes.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate silver chain circlet with a central blue gemstone, accented by a white feather and a small floral hairpin.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless bodice with a sweetheart neckline, encrusted with silver filigree, crystal beads, and pearl embroidery, featuring sheer detached arm drapes and a choker with a gemstone.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A flowing, layered tulle skirt with soft pleats and a sheer, trailing overskirt, paired with the suggestion of elegant, low-heeled silver slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A large, luminous white feather floating nearby, along with scattered crystal droplets and trailing pearl chains that evoke wind and sound.
